requirements.requirement: On node1, new interactive login sessions use a default umask of 027.
requirements.summary: A system-wide profile script sets umask 027. Fresh interactive login shells directly reported 0027 and created files with mode 0640 and directories with mode 0750, both before and after restart.

overall_summary: The task is fully satisfied. Node1 changed from a baseline umask of 0022 to 0027 for fresh interactive login shells, with correct resulting object permissions. Restart evidence is complete: healthy pre-restart state, acknowledged reboot, independently corroborated boot-ID change, and recovered system, SSH, configuration, and login behavior.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. The persistent profile script was the required implementation; temporary proof directories were bounded and removed; and the reboot was required by the provider-wide restart protocol. Post-executor observations show no failed services, no unexpected socket exposure, healthy package state, and no abandoned proof files.
